teaser: Credential injection for AI agents is a good pattern; the first question is still what an attacker can make the agent do.
core_idea: Keeping credentials out of AI agents and injecting them at a gateway is good practice, but a risk-based view asks first whether a leaked key can reach its target, would be seen, and how much it can do, and then what an injected agent can do without it; on an invented bank's day most incidents are business-logic misuse a credential gateway would let through, while the gateway adds an in-line system with its own costs.
